data.description:
## Description
**What**: Run the case-insensitive grep sweep for '5-rule' / 'five rules' / 'Rule 5' / behavioral-testing-standard across plugins/, tests/, and docs/, update the named consumer files, and triage every match into (i) updated to version-agnostic phrasing or extended to reference Rules 6/7, (ii) explicitly descoped with a one-line rationale, or (iii) already version-agnostic. Produce the full final grep output plus a per-match disposition table for the PR description.
**Why**: Adding Rules 6 and 7 makes any hardcoded 'five rules' / 'Rule 5' reference stale; this sweep prevents silent drift across consumers.
**Scope**:
- IN: The grep sweep; updates to the named consumer files; per-match triage disposition table; PR-description grep output.
- OUT: The Rule 6/7 text itself (draft-1); reviewer dimensions (draft-3).

## Done Definitions

- the grep sweep for '5-rule' / 'five rules' / 'Rule 5' / behavioral-testing-standard across plugins/, tests/, and docs/ returns no match that remains pinned to a stale five-rule count without a recorded disposition ← Satisfies: sc-6
- each named consumer file references the standard with version-agnostic phrasing or enumerates Rules 6 and 7, and red-test-evaluator.md rejection criteria require a Rule 6 header on new test output ← Satisfies: sc-6
- a per-match disposition table records each grep match against outcome (i), (ii), or (iii) with a one-line rationale for every (ii) descope ← Satisfies: sc-6
- the three rule5 test files assert the rule count version-agnostically and pass ← Satisfies: sc-6
- unit tests written and passing assert that the named consumer files contain version-agnostic phrasing ← Satisfies: sc-6
- When this story is complete, every new or modified test file authored by this story carries a valid Rule 6 '## Test Intent' header, consistent with the dogfood property of sc-7 ← Satisfies: sc-7

## Considerations

- [Coverage] Pattern validation confirmed 100% coverage of the 14 brainstorm-time consumers; this sweep catches any consumer added between brainstorm and implementation.
- [PR-artifact] The full final grep output and triage disposition must be embedded in the implementation PR description, not only in commit messages.
- [Dogfood] This story authors and modifies the three rule5 test files plus consumer-phrasing unit tests; those files must themselves carry a valid Rule 6 '## Test Intent' header, satisfying the sc-7 dogfood property on this story's own tests.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a maintainer, I want every '5-rule' / 'Rule 5' / behavioral-testing-standard reference grep-swept and triaged to version-agnostic phrasing, so no consumer pins a stale rule count
